summary.headline: Triple Captain has a credible current case
summary.principle: Use a chip when the current squad creates unusual incremental value, not simply because a chip is available.

reasons: Best current captain case: João Pedro vs Brighton H
A confirmed Double Gameweek materially raises Triple Captain value.
Best modeled window in the next five is GW2
4/4 bench players have a playable fixture; 2 have an easy one.
Bench Boost is strongest when all 15 players are healthy and the bench itself has real upside.
Best modeled bench window in the next five is GW4
Current squad has 0 players without a playable fixture and 0 weak fixtures.
Free Hit value rises sharply in a major blank or unusually concentrated double.
Best disruption window currently visible is GW3
Current structure flags 8 weak/availability-risk assets and 0 players with a poor next-three fixture run.
0 squad players already have a good next-three fixture run, reducing the need for a reset.
Very early Wildcards carry a high information cost: waiting reveals roles, form and team strength unless the squad is genuinely broken.

method_note: Heuristic decision support using current squad strength, availability, next-five fixtures, bench depth and confirmed FPL blank/double assignments. It is not a projected-points model.
